name: containerize-aspnet-framework
description: Containerize an ASP.NET .NET Framework project for Windows Docker by creating customized Dockerfile and .dockerignore files.

Containerize `[ProjectName (provide path to .csproj file)]` exclusively for Windows Docker; this is .NET Framework, not .NET Core. Settings: Windows Server SKU `[Windows Server Core (Default) or Windows Server Full]`; version `[2016, 2019, or 2022]`; build base `[Specify base image to use for build stage (Default None)]`; run base `[Specify base image to use for run stage (Default None)]`; ports primary `[e.g., 80]`, additional `[List any additional ports, or "None"]`; user `[User account, or default to "ContainerUser"]`; IIS `[List any specific IIS settings, or "None"]`; pre/post-build `[List any specific build steps, or "None"]`; GAC/MSI/COM `[Assembly name and version, or "None"]`; `[MSI names and versions, or "None"]`; `[COM component names, or "None"]`; registry/environment/roles `[Registry paths and values, or "None"]`; `[Variable names and values, or "Use defaults"]`; `[Role/feature names, or "None"]`; files/targets `[Paths relative to project root, or "None"]`; `[Container paths, or "Not applicable"]`; exclusions `[Paths to exclude, or "None"]`; .dockerignore `[List any additional patterns, or "None"]`; health `[Health check URL path, or "None"]`; `[Interval and timeout values, or "Use defaults"]`; other/known issues `[Specific requirements, or "None"]`; `[Describe any known issues, or "None"]`.

✅ App configuration modification to ensure config builders are used to read app settings and connection strings from the environment variables
✅ Dockerfile creation and configuration for an ASP.NET application
✅ Specifying multiple stages in the Dockerfile to build/publish the application and copy the output to the final image
✅ Configuration of Windows container platform compatibility (Windows Server Core or Full)
✅ Proper handling of dependencies (GAC assemblies, MSIs, COM components)
❌ No infrastructure setup (assumed to be handled separately)
❌ No code changes beyond those required for containerization

Procedure:
1. Review settings.
2. Create `progress.md` to track changes with check marks.
3. Determine .NET Framework from `.csproj` `TargetFrameworkVersion`.
4. Select Windows Server image by version/SKU/version (2016/2019/2022): https://github.com/microsoft/dotnet-framework-docker/blob/main/README.aspnet.md#full-tag-listing
5. Ensure required NuGet packages are installed. **DO NOT** install these if they are missing. If they are not installed, the user must install them manually. If they are not installed, pause executing this prompt and ask the user to install them using the Visual Studio NuGet Package Manager or Visual Studio package manager console. Required package: `Microsoft.Configuration.ConfigurationBuilders.Environment`.
6. Modify `web.config`: add ConfigBuilders section in configSections; add configBuilders root section; configure EnvironmentConfigBuilder for appSettings and connectionStrings:
```xml
